urls.rationale: Article 4 'Public Officials' Conduct and Lobbyist Disclosure' is Georgia's lobbyist-registration / lobbyist-expenditure-reporting body (O.C.G.A. 21-5-70 et seq.). The other articles in Ch. 5 are campaign-finance / financial-disclosure regimes that are out of scope.
Article 1 General Provisions hosts Ch. 5's shared definitions (O.C.G.A. 21-5-3) and the State Ethics Commission provisions cross-referenced by Article 4's lobbyist-disclosure rules.

notes: Tree is deeper than 3 levels (title > chapter > article > section); pass-3 selects article-4 as the core lobbying body and article-1 as support (definitions / ethics-commission). An intermediate pass-4 fetch on article-4 is needed to enumerate the section leaves.
